hypothesis: Eliminate the full payload copy by loading full source-prefix blocks directly, using destination blocks after the prefix, and handling at most one mixed batch.
oracle: 54 GCM seals derived by GcmSealFusedOracle.lean from Spec.Gcm; baseline plus eight public prefix choices each.

variants.3: direct-source kernel with TLS-style prefix and at most 16 copied suffix bytes

sampling: 25 interleaved samples per case from eight fresh copies; median of copy medians is primary; fastest-copy estimates also reported.
local_correctness: 486 full-seal outputs match Spec under qemu-ppc64le -cpu power8.
change: Use the registered nine-argument source-prefix helper, including its register preservation. The enclosing experimental seal always uses the helper and saves/restores its outgoing stack argument; no internal r17/r19 convention.
scope: Enclosing seal remains an unverified probe; the helper is the exact Impl.AesGcm.PPC64LE.SplitBlocks.encrypt program verified and registered at the recorded revision. Public Rust API timing is not measured here.
